title: Scalar twisted-unit exchange component without Chern data
statement: For a prime l, scalar coefficient c, field k of characteristic p ≠ l, and a k-scheme Y, the scalar twisted-unit exchange equation holds with the definitions of scalarTwistedUnit, scalarQLineIso, secondLineComparison, and secondTraceExchange. The completed Chern and reference data are absent because they do not occur in this component equation.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K.

proof.text: Expand scalarTwistedUnit and secondTraceExchange as the adjunction units, the ambient exchange mate, and the root-normalized line comparisons. Apply the unit_mateEquiv identity for the two derived adjunctions and the naturality of the ambient exchange; the remaining line comparison is the prescribed secondLineComparison. This is the categorical unit component and does not use completed Chern normalization.

proof_origin.place: Second identity, unit component after removing unused Chern data

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_p1_unit_mate_component
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] :
    let Λ := (coefficient l c).X
    let L := line l c
    let T := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ X) 0).obj (L X)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    let uq := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (T Y) (T (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (scalarQLineIso l c k p hpl Y)
    let u₂ := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (secondProjection Y)
      (T (ProjectiveLine Y)) (T (diagonalSurface Y)) (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y)
    let F := moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
    F.map uq ≫ secondTraceExchange l c k p hpl Y =
        (scalarQLineIso l c k p hpl Y).hom ≫ u₂
